title: Glauber cutoff throughout the high-temperature SK phase
exact_target: For each fixed $0\leq \beta <1$, does worst-start heat-bath dynamics for Gaussian SK have total-variation cutoff at (log n)/(2lambda(beta)) in continuous site-rate-one time and at n times that scale in single-update discrete time, in disorder probability? Require a deterministic $\lambda (\beta )>0$, $\lambda (0)=1$, and $\lambda (\beta )\leq (1-\beta )^2$.
